fields.DESCRIPTION: Crafted with traditional skill by Rajasthani artisans, this handmade wooden bowl is a beautiful blend of functionality and rustic charm. The natural wood grain patterns give it a unique character, while the smooth polished finish enhances its elegance. Its medium depth makes it ideal for serving dry fruits, snacks, dips, chutneys, or even as a decorative piece. Eco-friendly and durable, this bowl is a versatile addition to your kitchen and dining collection.
